method: straight and L-shaped corridors (net-class track width + 2 x clearance) between the two endpoints of each unconnected item, per copper layer; heuristic pointer, not a proof

category_notes.keepout: rule area: part of the design's constraints; route around it, never edit it
category_notes.input_copper: copper from the attempt's input: moving it needs the owner's permission (--protect locked frees only unlocked input copper)
category_notes.new_copper: the backend's own output in this attempt: cheap to rip (re-route in another order or scope)
category_notes.footprint: pads of other nets: placement is fixed for routing; go around or change layer
category_notes.board_edge: the corridor leaves the board outline
